purpose: Pinned, checksummed toolchain for the ACP/OCSF worked-example prototype (NON-PRODUCTION). Reproduce with scripts/run_all.sh.

ocsf_schema_compiler.runtime: CPython 3.14.2 via uv 0.9.17 (uv python install 3.14); run from source with PYTHONPATH=src

ocsf_toolkit.sha256_source: release SHA256SUMS; equals the archive checksum recorded in the steward's 2026-10-20 investigation
ocsf_toolkit.binary_sha256_source: sha256 of the ocsf-toolkit executable extracted from the pinned archive; every committed validation summary records it, and the requirements accounting compares it
ocsf_toolkit.built_with: go1.27.1 (per the binary's own summary metadata)
limits: validates one JSON object per file (--event or --events-dir); JSONL input is not supported at v0.9.0, so adapt.py writes events/NNNN.json beside events.jsonl
enum sibling values that differ from the schema caption are warnings
integral floats satisfy integer_t; explicit null equals absence (not probed here)

acp_vocabulary.scope: v1 documentation only; no ACP runtime or transport dependency

extension.name: agentic_cli
extension.uid_status: PROVISIONAL, UNREGISTERED; alternate assignment 902 is compiled only to demonstrate reader refusal
extension.bundled_excerpt: journal-ocsf-writer/src/main/resources/ocsf/compiled-excerpt-agentic_cli-0.11.0-prototype.json (derived by SchemaExcerpt from the whole compiled.json; carries source_compiled_schema.sha256)

mcp_protocol_schemas.binding: journal-ocsf-writer/src/main/resources/ocsf/mcp/binding.json (McpBindingGenerator binding 0.1.0; regenerated and compared by McpProtocolContainmentTest)
mcp_protocol_schemas.validator: com.networknt:json-schema-validator 1.5.7 (draft 2020-12) in journal-capture-tck McpValidation; reading and checks only, never the writer's path

java_reader.reader_contract: agent-journal/ocsf-reader 0.3 (reads 0.2 packages with a minor-version warning)
java_reader.package_layout: 0.1.0-prototype and 0.2.0-prototype (two-file cores, definitions in run.json) and 0.3.0-prototype (standalone events.jsonl with declaration records; run.json ancillary)

not_adopted: development-head schema a7e16ed3 (ai_status, ai_capability): crosswalk only

java_writer.reader_contract: agent-journal/ocsf-reader 0.3 (reads 0.2 packages with a minor-version warning)
java_writer.status: NON-PRODUCTION incremental writer; no production default uses it
